title: README news catches up
summary:
A quiet day: the README caught up with recent model and CLI news.

The README’s Latest News section now covers the July 10 entries for GPT 5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna, Seedream 5 Pro, and Polli CLI’s Pollen and Quest tracking. Older entries were removed to keep the list current. This was a documentation update, not a change to those features.
